text: This is citEther… Follow Me Power.
caption: citEther · Follow Me Power
delivery: Calm and inviting, with a quiet hint of intrigue. Let the title breathe.

text: Every sunny day, a rooftop makes more power than the home can use. The battery fills… and then there's surplus — clean energy, with nowhere to go.
caption: Solar + full battery
delivery: Warm and observational; bright and unhurried, like noticing something hopeful.

text: Today, that surplus has only one option — sell it back to the grid, for almost nothing. Your energy… trapped at the meter.
caption: Trapped at the meter
delivery: Empathetic, with a touch of quiet frustration. Slow down and lean on 'trapped at the meter.'

text: Meanwhile, the same person needs power somewhere else. A job site across town. A parent's flat. An electric car, far from home.
caption: Needed elsewhere
delivery: Three even beats — steady, measured rhythm across the three places.

text: Worth almost nothing… here. Expensive… there. The value is real — the connection isn't.
caption: Cheap here · costly there
delivery: Slow and pointed; let the unfairness sit. Gentle stress on the contrast 'here' versus 'there.'

text: citEther changes that. The grid still supplies the electricity… citEther settles the value. And your surplus becomes credit — credit you can use anywhere.
caption: Grid = electricity · citEther = value
delivery: A hopeful lift. Clear, confident; pause after 'citEther settles the value.'

text: Your energy account is no longer tied to your address… It follows you.
caption: Your account follows you
delivery: Gentle wonder, reassuring. Let 'It follows you' land softly.

text: Power your mum's flat — from your roof. The grid keeps her lights on… your solar covers the bill.
caption: Powering Mum's flat
delivery: Tender and sincere — the warmest, most heartfelt moment of the film.

text: Run the tools on the job site from home solar — and switch the diesel generator off.
caption: Diesel off
delivery: Confident and satisfying, with a small sense of resolution on 'off.'

text: Charge your car at the coast… and let this morning's sunshine pay for it.
caption: Coast charge offset
delivery: Light, easy, almost a smile in the voice.

text: Park at the hospital, and your car can steady a strained part of the grid — earning real value, while you work.
caption: Supports the grid · earns
delivery: Respectful and credible, with a quiet touch of pride.

text: Use it. Share it. Donate it. Sell it. Always a better option — than exporting for almost nothing.
caption: Use · Share · Donate · Sell
delivery: Crisp and rhythmic on the four short verbs, then ease back to land the closing line.

text: Share it with your street first… and the value stays local.
caption: Local Pod first

text: Even after the network's fees, a day's surplus is worth many times a feed-in tariff. The numbers… hold up.
caption: Net beats zero FiT
delivery: Grounded, matter-of-fact, trustworthy — like stating a plain truth.

text: Energy should follow people — not just meters. citEther. Your energy… follows you. One suburb. One hundred homes. Three months.
caption: Your energy follows you
delivery: Slow and visionary, gently building. Let 'your energy follows you' breathe before the closing three phrases.
